Политику ходьбы награждают только за ско: A walking policy is rewarded only for the torso's forward speed. What will it most likely learn?
Ровную быструю походку: скорость и есть: A steady, fast gait: speed is what walking is
Любой способ двигаться вперёд, в том чис: Any way of moving forward, including lying down: the reward doesn't say the torso has to be above the floor
Стоять на месте: любой шаг рискует паден: To stand still: any step risks a fall
В лаборатории 1 Ада с наградой только за: In Lab 1, the Ada rewarded only for speed falls within 0.6 s and then lies on the floor pushing off with her legs, moving at 1.37 m/s, faster than the full-reward Ada. The reward says what to achieve, not how; that's why Rudin et al. use nine terms, and Margolis and Agrawal eighteen.
Зачем на обучении каждой копии дают свою: Why does each copy get its own random velocity command during training?
Чтобы копии в симуляторе не мешали друг: So that simulator copies don't interfere
Чтобы политика научилась связывать число: So the policy learns to link the number in its input to speed: if the command is always the same, the input says nothing and isn't worth reading
В лаборатории 2 Ада с одной командой при: In Lab 2, the single-command Ada walked at 0.71 m/s at a command of 0.9 m/s, and at about 0.68 m/s after the command jumped to 0.8 m/s. The random-command Ada held both 0.3 and 0.9 m/s. Hwangbo et al. sample commands from intervals, and Radosavovic et al. pick a new one every 10 seconds.
Почему политика ходьбы выдаёт целевые уг: Why does a walking policy output target joint angles rather than motor torques?
Так проще посчитать градиент: The gradient is easier to compute
С целевыми углами и ПД-регулятором робот: With target angles and a PD controller, the robot can stand from the very start of training, while a policy that outputs torques would first have to learn not to fall
Моменты моторов у настоящих роботов зада: Real robots don't let you set motor torques
Так объясняют выбор Hwangbo и соавторы,: That's how Hwangbo et al. explain their choice, and the policies of Rudin et al., Margolis and Agrawal, and Radosavovic et al. work the same way. On Digit, the policy also outputs PD gains for the leg joints, and the PD controllers themselves run 20 times more often than the policy.
Копии в симуляторе почти ничего не стоят: Copies in a simulator cost almost nothing. Why don't Rudin et al. take ten times more of them with the same rollout batch?
Видеокарта не вмещает больше копий: The GPU can't fit more copies
При той же порции у каждой копии остаётс: With the same batch, each copy gets fewer consecutive steps, and GAE needs the rewards of several consecutive steps
Чем больше копий, тем больше ошибок симу: The more copies, the more simulator errors
Авторы видели, что качество резко падает: The authors saw performance drop sharply when there are fewer than 25 consecutive steps, that is, less than 0.5 s. For a batch of about 100,000 steps, they name 2,048–4,096 robots as the best compromise, and training time falls almost linearly up to 4,000 robots.
В лаборатории 3 поиск с 32 копиями проиг: In Lab 3, the search with 32 copies lost to eight copies on the same episode budget. What follows from this?
Бюджет ушёл на точность каждого обновлен: The budget went into the accuracy of each update, leaving too few updates: with an equal number of updates, 32 copies beat eight
Копий всегда должно быть восемь: There should always be eight copies
При бюджете 960 эпизодов 32 копиям хвати: With a budget of 960 episodes, 32 copies could afford only 5 updates and scored 37 on the check versus 89 for eight copies. With an equal five updates, 32 copies, on the contrary, beat eight: 37 versus 15. In Isaac Gym, thousands of copies are computed on one GPU at once, so there, copies cost almost nothing.
Робота Digit толкнули, и политика тут же: Digit was pushed, and the policy changed its steps immediately. What changed in it?
Веса сети: она дообучается прямо на ходу: The network's weights: it fine-tunes on the fly
История во входе: последние пары «наблюд: The history in its input: the latest “observation, action” pairs became unusual, and the network with the same weights outputs different actions
Ничего: политика не замечает толчков, их: Nothing: the policy ignores pushes, the PD controllers absorb them
Radosavovic и соавторы называют это адап: Radosavovic et al. call this in-context adaptation, by analogy with language models, which change their answer based on a prompt without changing their weights. In ablations, the transformer over history beat MLP, TCN and LSTM, and a long context turned out better than a short one.
Политика ANYmal у Rudin и соавторов ходи: The ANYmal policy of Rudin et al. trots. Where in the reward is the trot specified?
В слагаемом за время стопы в воздухе: In the feet air time term
Нигде: ни награда, ни пространство дейст: Nowhere: neither the reward nor the action space depends on the gait, and the trot emerges on its own
Время стопы в воздухе поощряет только дл: Feet air time only rewards long steps. The authors removed artifacts such as a dragging leg by tuning the weights, and for the two-legged Cassie they added a reward for standing on a single foot. Margolis and Agrawal, on the contrary, feed gait parameters into the input, and a single policy walks with different gaits.
Почему слагаемое за следование команде у: Why is Rudin et al.'s command tracking term bounded, exp(−error²/0.25), rather than equal to minus the squared error?
Если штраф растёт с ошибкой без предела,: If the penalty grows without bound, then with a large error it pays more to fall and end the episode than to chase the command
Ограниченная награда нужна, чтобы работа: GAE only works with a bounded reward
Об этом прямо пишут Hwangbo и соавторы:: Hwangbo et al. say this directly: with the Euclidean norm of the error, falling becomes the more rewarding strategy. A bounded reward for every step, on the contrary, makes every step without a fall worth it.
